style: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: square text-free illustration for a biblical encyclopedia. Refined naturalistic watercolor with subtle gouache, warm parchment, ochre and olive tones, restrained navy accents, soft natural light, ancient Levant setting where relevant, clear uncluttered composition. No text, letters, labels, border, watermark, modern objects. Do not portray God as a human.
